clauses.requirement: Rear position lamps (R1, R2, MR) and rear end-outline marker lamps (RM1, RM2) (UN R148 para 5.2.3): no minimum or maximum area of apparent surface is required.

Rear position lamps (R1, R2, MR) and rear end-outline marker lamps (RM1, RM2), measurement (UN R148 para 5.2.4): for end-outline marker lamps RM1 and RM2, the standard light distribution may be considered, at the request of the applicant, from the VV line to the outboard only.
Rear position lamps (R1, R2, MR) and rear end-outline marker lamps (RM1, RM2) (UN R148 para 5.2.5): there are no additional specific requirements.
Rear position lamps (R1, R2, MR) and rear end-outline marker lamps (RM1, RM2), failure provisions (UN R148 para 5.2.6): the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6 shall be met.
Rear position lamps (R1, R2, MR) and rear end-outline marker lamps (RM1, RM2), colour (UN R148 para 5.2.7): the colour of the light emitted shall be red.
Parking lamps (77R), UN R148 para 5.3 heading: the specific technical requirements of paragraph 5.3 apply to parking lamps (77R), applicable only if the lamp includes a parking lamp function.

Parking lamps (77R), luminous intensity and standard light distribution (UN R148 para 5.3.1): the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements of Table 5; however, a luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd shall be permitted for parking lamps directed to the rear incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.

Parking lamps, Table 5 luminous intensities: forward-facing parking lamps shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 2∙10^0 cd and a maximum of 6.0∙10^1 cd; rearward-facing parking lamps shall have a minimum of 2∙10^0 cd and a maximum of 3.0∙10^1 cd; the standard light distribution is per Figure A3-I (para 4.8.3.1(b)); the angles of geometric visibility are per Table A2-1 (para 4.8.3.1(d)); the minimum luminous intensity definition is 5∙10^-2 cd (para 4.8.3.1(c)).
